chapter: Chicago memories and the road to the Navy
title: Jelly Roll Morton, respected and boastful
summary: Zutty says Jelly Roll was respected though people gave him hell for bragging; his claims to know where Tiger Rag came from were credible.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Well in other words, Jelly Roll though was, you see a lot of people always want to put him down. And he was widely known and respected by this time was he, Jelly Roll?

Sure Jelly Roll was respected. They tried to give Jelly hell because he bragged so much. He could tell you where this came from. Where 'Tiger Rag' came from and everything. See, that's the kind of guy he was.
He knew. You can tell from the numbers he wrote. The tunes he wrote, but boy
